about: The public demo's free library: tools/demo-seed.py library deploy/demo/library.json --library ./library --fetch. Every title carries its rights record (sofa/rights.py); each source page was read on the date in 'checked'. Read them again before seeding. 'hold' keeps a title out until someone decides (it says who and why).

titles.title: Big Buck Bunny
titles.summary: A large and gentle rabbit takes his revenge on three rodents who torment the forest's smaller creatures. A short animated film from the Blender Foundation's Peach open movie project.

rights.changes: Played from Wikimedia Commons' 720p VP9 copy of the original 4K file, re-encoded by Wikimedia; nothing else changed.

titles.title: Apollo 11: First Steps on the Moon
titles.summary: NASA's television pictures of the Apollo 11 landing and the first steps on the Moon, 20 July 1969. About a minute.

rights.basis: Made by NASA, a US federal agency: no copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105). NASA's own Apollo 11 multimedia page offers it. NASA's name and insignia aren't used to suggest it endorses this site.
rights.changes: Played from Wikimedia Commons' 240p VP9 copy of NASA's file, re-encoded by Wikimedia; nothing else changed.

titles.title: Night of the Living Dead
titles.hold: Public domain in the United States; outside it, unsettled. Its director died in 2017, so if the UK and the EU count it by their own terms it is in copyright there until at least 2087; whether the rule of the shorter term carries the US status over is a lawyer's question. Held until the lawyer's view (docs/public-demo.md).
titles.summary: Strangers shelter in a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise. George A. Romero's first film.

rights.basis: Public domain in the United States: published there in 1968 without a copyright notice (before 1978, a notice was required). Outside the US: not settled.
rights.changes: Played from Wikimedia Commons' 480p VP9 copy of the file there, re-encoded by Wikimedia; nothing else changed.
